title: 美银今年花约3亿美元：在AI上，却说关键看最终需求
speaker: Brian Moynihan

segments.en: of the sort of overhang of what that backstop looks like financially to so many different companies. Well, I think that's been a question, the high quality credit companies that are backstops to data center build-outs or purchases of chips or whatever.
segments.zh: 许多公司面临的财务支持问题。我认为，对于数据中心建设或芯片采购等提供支持的高质量信贷公司，这一直是个问题。

segments.en: You know, when we look at it from a lending and credit risk perspective, that's what we look at.
segments.zh: 从贷款和信贷风险的角度来看，这就是我们所关注的。

segments.en: If you think about there's a building out there and a capacity.
segments.zh: 想想那里有一栋建筑和产能。

segments.en: There's a physical plan. And there's also the chips. And who is behind the commitments?
segments.zh: 有一个实体计划。还有芯片。谁在背后承诺？

segments.en: And we look for companies that are creditworthy. And then we make sure we only lend them when they're completely permitted and ready to go and then you help them build.
segments.zh: 我们寻找有信誉的公司。然后确保只在他们完全获准并准备就绪时放贷，然后帮助他们建设。

segments.en: But I think that's going to be the great debate, which is how does the final demand from companies like us spending money on AI?
segments.zh: 但我认为这将是一场大辩论，即像我们这样的公司花钱在AI上的最终需求如何。

segments.en: For you spending money on AI, personally, directly by paying a fee or indirectly by the revenue attached to what you do on it.
segments.zh: 对于你们在AI上花钱，无论是直接付费还是通过你们所做事情的相关收入间接付费。

segments.en: How big that will be, how that materializes over time.
segments.zh: 这将有多大，如何随时间实现。

segments.en: That will ultimately determine the viability of all this.
segments.zh: 这最终将决定这一切的可行性。

segments.en: And right now we see in our company, AI is very strong.
segments.zh: 目前在我们公司，AI非常强劲。

segments.en: It works. We've spent about 300 million on it this year.
segments.zh: 它有效。我们今年在这上面花了约3亿美元。

segments.en: In terms of an issue, it's not necessarily all to the AI or to bottle builders and things like that.
segments.zh: 就问题而言，并不一定全归因于AI或瓶装建筑商之类的。

segments.en: But on an issue, it's to get about 700 million of value, so you feel good about it.
segments.zh: 但就问题而言，是要获得约7亿美元的价值，所以你会感觉不错。
